meta.title: Public RSSI recruitment signals in Nouvelle-Aquitaine
meta.method: Six public search pages (three title queries, two date-sorted ranges). Only offers located in a Nouvelle-Aquitaine department with a strict RSSI/CISO title are kept. Publication day comes from the relative label shown on the page. Organisation names and department codes only: no candidate, contact or victim data.
meta.limitation: The public board exposes mostly offers from the last 30 days; older recruitments are not observable from this source.
